sources.AI_BODY: AUTOSAR CP R21-11, AUTOSAR_EXP_AIBodyAndComfort (ID 268), chapter 4 decompositions
sources.AI_OPS: AUTOSAR CP R21-11, AUTOSAR_EXP_AIOccupantAndPedestrianSafety (ID 271), software compositions SWCo 001-401
sources.AI_CHASSIS: AUTOSAR CP R21-11, AUTOSAR_EXP_AIChassis (ID 270), chapter 4 software components
sources.AI_PT: AUTOSAR CP R22-11, AUTOSAR_EXP_AIPowertrain (ID 269), chapter 5 (PtCoorr, Trsm, CmbEng, VehMtnForPt, PtMisc)
sources.AI_HMI: AUTOSAR CP R25-11, AUTOSAR_CP_EXP_AIHMIMultimediaAndTelematics (ID 272): application service / controller / UI device SW-Cs, InterDomainController
sources.INFINEON_INV: Infineon AN1101 / AP32540: traction inverter FOC on AURIX TC3xx, current loop 50 us (20 kHz), speed loop 5 ms, FTTI <= 60 ms; unintended torque ASIL D
sources.INFINEON_EPS: Infineon AN1100: EPS on AURIX TC3xx, torque / angle sensors, FTTI of the order of milliseconds; unwanted steering ASIL D
sources.NXP_BMS: NXP HVBMS reference design: MC33771C cell controllers, S32K344 BMU; architecture ASIL D
sources.CARIAD: Denzinger, Becker, Ulbrich, arXiv 2605.04837 (ECRTS 2026): ASIL share, ROM/RAM, periods, WCET, chains of a motion-and-drive ECU
sources.AUDIO: IEC 60908 CD audio 1.4112 Mbit/s; IEEE 802.1Q AVB class A 125 us observation interval
sources.V2X: ETSI EN 302 637-2 CAM 1-10 Hz; C2C-CC TR 2052 CAM 200 to >700 B
sources.TELLTALE: TI SPRADC8 / embedded cluster safety notes: cluster telltales ASIL B
sources.GATEWAY: NXP S32G2/S32G3 product pages: central gateway, PFE / LLCE accelerators, ASIL D SoC
sources.ISO26262_EX: ISO 26262-3 / SAE J2980 example classifications: airbag, braking, steering ASIL D; lighting A-B; comfort QM-A (secondary sources, to be confirmed)

reference.name: Autoware PoV reference design, Vision Pilot Plus (Phase 2, SAE Level 3)
reference.sensor_set: 1 front RGB camera, 1 front 4D radar, 2 corner radars
reference.source: https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main/system-configuration (rough GPU requirements: Vision Pilot 50-80, Plus 150, Pro 500, Vision Drive 1000 TOPS; 2025.09) and https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main (sensors per tier)
reference.decision: user 2026-11-05: Plus; the same TOPS per sensor applied to our 8 cameras + 5 lidars (a lidar counted like a radar); the rho margins apply on top (rho 1: 488 TOPS raw x 3.32 = 1,617 TOPS)

components.tops_source: gpu_demand (tools/arch_v3_gpu_demand.py, configs/gpu_demand.json): Autoware PoV reference design, Vision Pilot Plus (Phase 2, SAE Level 3), 150 TOPS for 4 sensors = 37.5 TOPS per sensor, applied to this car's cameras and lidars; https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main/system-configuration (rough GPU requirements: Vision Pilot 50-80, Plus 150, Pro 500, Vision Drive 1000 TOPS; 2025.09) and https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main (sensors per tier); measured network of CAM_Front_Center, its TOPS set to the per-sensor share (was 1.79)
components.source: measured: camera run (Leo Drive bag, 2 traffic-light cameras), container of the YOLOX fine detector and the classifiers
components.cpu_dmips_source: measured per thread 2026-11-03 (camera run, autoware_bench/out_cam2): work thread 59.5 %% + CUDA event thread 5.5 %% of a host core at 15.8 Hz, scaled to 10 Hz, x 2.56 x 12,250 DMIPS; the 270 executor polling threads of the 256-CPU host (190 %%) excluded; upper bound (the GPU wait sits inside the work thread)
